name: Snake
style: low-poly, flat colours, cartoon (Quaternius 2019): oversized head and eyes, fangs, forked tongue

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Plan row 49 names the snake from Quaternius Animated Creatures/Dinosaurs on poly.pizza (clips Snake_Attack, Snake_Idle, Snake_Jump, Snake_Walk); poly.pizza is behind a Cloudflare challenge, so it comes from the same author's Easy Animated Enemy Pack (Jan 2019) on itch.io, which carries exactly those four clips. The itch page states CC0; the zip ships no licence file. The pack has two snakes, Snake.fbx and Snake_angry.fbx (the same body plus dark brow ridges); the plain one is used, because the brows read as horns or ears in the cel look and lock the face to one expression. It is a cartoon snake (head and eyes about twice real proportion), so the height is a chosen size, not a measured one: 0.2 m to the top of the reared head at rest, which makes the body about 0.5 m long and 7 cm thick, a small snake such as a corn snake. Colours on the noon script: accent-red scales with iris-brown shade (a corn snake), tan belly with skin shade, cream eyes with near-black slit pupils, skin-pink mouth, cream fangs, brown tongue. Ground: no clip sinks (probe min y 0 on every frame); Snake_Jump leaves the ground for real (up to 8.7 cm) and lands, so it is not clamped.
